credits.aqicn: Current values from the World Air Quality Index project (https://aqicn.org), relaying NEA and DOE. Data not verified by aqicn; not for paid use; its archive is not kept.
credits.GIBS: We acknowledge the use of imagery provided by services from NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS). Real Earth: VIIRS on NOAA-20, Suomi NPP and NOAA-21, corrected reflectance, true colour, with NASA's Blue Marble where none saw anything; smoke from space: VIIRS Deep Blue on NOAA-20, Suomi NPP and NOAA-21, aerosol optical depth, the last 3 days; carbon monoxide: AIRS on Aqua, 500 hPa, the last 6 days. credits.GFS: Wind: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Prediction (NCEP), Global Forecast System (GFS), 10 m wind at 1 degree, via NOMADS (https://nomads.ncep.noaa.gov). A computer model's estimate.
credits.CelesTrak: Orbit data: CelesTrak (https://celestrak.org), general perturbations elements, fetched at most once per 2-hour update.
